
The poll engine of `lode task reconcile` (WL-REQ-297) picks as candidates the tasks whose delivery state can still advance, paired with each repo where they have a recorded PR or commit; a tombstoned task is never polled. Per task, mint an installation token and read the PRs' real `state`/`merged`/`merge_commit_sha`, whether recorded commits are on the default branch, and which releases contain them. Missing facts are written through `UpsertPR` / `InsertTaskCommit` / `AppendMainCommit`, then `ResolveDelivery` runs; it derives delivery state from facts, so there is no state machine to replay. One `source='system'` event per run (type `reconcile.poll`, `external_id` = run id) receives attribution for facts and transitions. Requests batch per repo against one installation token.
